grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · THERE IS / THERE ARE
grammar.sub: Describing what exists in a place
grammar.explanation: There is = có (số ít). There are = có (số nhiều). Dùng để mô tả đồ vật trong phòng. Phủ định: There isn't / There aren't. Câu hỏi: Is there...? / Are there...?
grammar.explanationVi: There is = có (số ít). There are = có (số nhiều). Dùng để mô tả đồ vật trong phòng. Phủ định: There isn't / There aren't. Câu hỏi: Is there...? / Are there...?
lines: There is a table in the kitchen.
There are four chairs in the living room.
There isn't a TV in the bedroom.
There aren't any windows in the bathroom.
Is there a lamp on the table?
Are there any books on the shelf?
commonMistakes: Sai: 'There are a table.' → Đúng: 'There is a table.'
Sai: 'There is four chairs.' → Đúng: 'There are four chairs.'
Sai: 'Is there any chairs?' → Đúng: 'Are there any chairs?'
practice: There ___ a sofa in the living room.
There ___ two bedrooms in the house.
___ there a kitchen on the first floor?
There ___ any lamps in the bedroom.

grammar.section: GRAMMAR IN USE · PREPOSITIONS OF PLACE
grammar.sub: in, on, under, next to, between, in front of, behind
grammar.explanation: In = trong (phòng, hộp). On = trên (bàn, tường). Under = dưới. Next to = bên cạnh. Between = giữa. In front of = phía trước. Behind = phía sau.
grammar.explanationVi: In = trong (phòng, hộp). On = trên (bàn, tường). Under = dưới. Next to = bên cạnh. Between = giữa. In front of = phía trước. Behind = phía sau.
lines: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
The lamp is next to the bed.
The kitchen is between the living room and the bedroom.
The TV is in front of the sofa.
The garden is behind the house.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'The book is in the table.' → Đúng: 'The book is on the table.'
Sai: 'The cat is on the chair.' (dưới ghế) → Đúng: 'The cat is under the chair.'
Sai: 'The lamp is between the bed.' → Đúng: 'The lamp is next to the bed.'
practice: The chair is ___ the desk and the window.

reading.title: My New Apartment
reading.text: I moved to a new apartment last month. It is small but nice. There are two rooms: a bedroom and a living room. There is a kitchen and a bathroom. In the bedroom, there is a bed and a wardrobe. There is also a small desk next to the window. In the living room, there is a sofa and a TV. The kitchen has a table and two chairs. There is a lamp on the table. The bathroom is small but clean. I like my new apartment. It is cozy and comfortable.

questions.q: How many rooms are there in the apartment?
How does the person feel about the apartment?
